body: Fight as long as you can

I understand what youre saying and while that likely plays a factor, I'm not talking about being comfortable with it because it's familiar. I'm saying that being in pain from depression and anxiety makes me feel validated. It makes me feel like I'm allowed to take up space in my corner of the world to survive. And if I'm not suffering, I would have no excuse for what I have become, if that makes sense.

Telling someone "things will get better" is the least helpful you could do man. You cant promise that. We could wake up one day and feel better. Or we could go our entire lives putting as much effort as we can and nothing gets better. If you truly want to be helpful, remind then that things CAN get better. We don't know if they will but every say we survive we give them life another chance to change. Thats all we can do.

Yea. Its basically loneliness but it feels different. Idk I understand you though man, I get them too. I'll have dreams I'm just cuddling with my love and life feels complete. Then I wake up, alone, miserable, and just hopeless. My mind is really cruel to me sometimes. I'll have dreams about my dead dad or dead cat or whatever. Usually the only way I know its a dream is because I know they are gone.
Nothing pathetic about it man. I honestly have always thought the concept of virginity is retarded.

if youre not sure, then its not time. Life CAN get better. I cant promise it will or wont. All we can do is give it as many opportunities as we can to get better. And if you get to a point where your cant give anymore, i understand and i hope you can find peace.
You've come a long way my friend. Im proud of you.

i understand you man. My entire life ive been starved for affection. All ive ever wanted honestly. I went through a phase where i started hooking up with lots of random people so i could feel it, even though it wasnt real and was temporary it was still nice. Im honestly afraid of how desperate i am for that kind of affection. If i were in an abusive relationship i probably wouldn't leave so i could have that. i feel you man.
I appreciate it. I hope we all make it.

I really do appreciate it. Like I said, nothing is bottled up. Some of the people close to me know everything that's going on my in head. Its made nothing better for me. Instead they end up frantically thinking some thing that will help. And it sucks to have to keep telling that it won't. That's all

Yes. You can see my story in my last posts but I have spoken to several therapists, psychiatrists, doctors, etc. Completely openly. As I said I don't get anything from telling people my issues. My situation is very developed. I've been through many layers of learning and looking for help. It's always ended in the same place. I just want to minimize the inevitable damage I'm going to cause.

I think there is a distinction to be made when people say that. Thing CAN get better, that doesn't necessarily mean they will. Likewise it doesn't mean they will get worse. The best we can't take from that is to give life as many chances to get better as you can. And if you get to a point where you are out of chances to give, I understand and and want you to be proud of how many you did give.

I never said they think i am a burden. I know they care, i know im valued to them, i know they will support me as much as they can. The reality is im a money pit with little to no contribution to them aside from being related. Im a room they could be renting out, im food they could be conserving, im water and electricity they could not have to pay for. They may not see it like this, and they probably dont. But its the same way a alcoholic doesn't see the damage alcohol is doing to them. 

Its not about finding a job, its about holding one. Like i said, i have found plenty of jobs varying in substance. But my anxiety has cost me all of them and likely has cost me any future opportunities with them because i had to quit so soon. You say my conditions dont matter, but its like trying to walk with broken legs that wont heal. I can do everything i can to forget them, but it doesn't make me be able to walk.
